for i, t in enumerate(transitions):
    before = t.before_frame
    after = t.after_frame
    before_seg = before.segmentation
    after_seg = after.segmentation
    
    # Get gray node pixels
    before_g = [n for n in before_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'G'][0]
    after_g = [n for n in after_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'G'][0]
    
    # Get white node pixels  
    before_w = [n for n in before_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
    after_w = [n for n in after_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
    
    # Check adjacency changes
    before_adj = set(tuple(sorted(a)) for a in before_seg['adjacency_list'])
    after_adj = set(tuple(sorted(a)) for a in after_seg['adjacency_list'])
    adj_changed = before_adj != after_adj
    
    action_name = t.action if hasattr(t, 'action') else str(t)
    print(f"Action {i}: {action_name}")
    print(f"  G: {before_g['pixels']} -> {after_g['pixels']}, W: {[n['pixels'] for n in before_w]} -> {[n['pixels'] for n in after_w]}")
    if adj_changed:
        added = after_adj - before_adj
        removed = before_adj - after_adj
        if added: print(f"  Added adj: {added}")
        if removed: print(f"  Removed adj: {removed}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
